name: codex-tower
description: Local multi-chat task status tracking and macOS sound notifications for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Track Codex chats and hear status changes.
interface.longDescription: A privacy-first local task tracker for Codex chats. It stores only task metadata, uses lifecycle hooks to track status, and plays distinct macOS sounds for attention and completion.
defaultPrompt: Show my Codex Tower task statuses.
Mark this Codex task complete in Codex Tower.
